sinopsis.es: En plena campaña, un diputado se entera por la radio de que está envuelto en un escándalo. Él y su esposa buscan en internet qué fue lo que pasó.
sinopsis.en: This morning, Paul Sérédat, a member of parliament campaigning for reelection, hears it on the radio: he has slipped up. And apparently, not just a little! He panics: what on earth could he have said to deserve such a media storm? He rushes to his computer to uncover the source of the scandal.
